hints.title: Increasing Run Detection
hints.text: Notice that two adjacent subarrays of length k each span a total contiguous range of 2k elements, split into two strictly increasing blocks.

hints.title: Consecutive Runs
hints.text: Compute the lengths of all maximal strictly increasing contiguous runs.

hints.title: Adjacency Comparison
hints.text: If a single run has length at least 2k, or if two adjacent runs have lengths each at least k, then such adjacent subarrays exist.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear scan verifying strictly increasing conditions on adjacent windows of length k.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force checking all pairs of subarrays takes O(n * k).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Solves in single linear pass tracking contiguous increasing runs.
